newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH SEASON TO START EARLY WITH FRANCE 98 IN MIND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH SEASON TO START EARLY WITH FRANCE 98 IN MIND.

text.p: The English soccer season will start and finish slightly earlier next year to allow the national side more time to prepare for the 1998 World Cup finals.
The premier league season will kick off on August 9 -- a week earlier than normal -- and end on the second weekend in May.
The change will give England coach Glenn Hoddle a month to prepare for the finals in France should his side qualify. The World Cup is due to start on June 10 and end on July 12.
